questions: Which 5 countries gained the most life expectancy between 1990 and 2020, and what was their GDP per capita in 2020?
results.answer_sql: WITH life_exp_1990 AS (SELECT ENTITY, LIFE_EXPECTANCY FROM OWID.PUBLIC.LIFE_EXPECTANCY WHERE YEAR = 1990 AND (LENGTH(CODE) = 3 OR CODE = 'OWID_KOS')), life_exp_2020 AS (SELECT ENTITY, LIFE_EXPECTANCY FROM OWID.PUBLIC.LIFE_EXPECTANCY WHERE YEAR = 2020 AND (LENGTH(CODE) = 3 OR CODE = 'OWID_KOS')), gdp_2020 AS (SELECT ENTITY, GDP_PER_CAPITA FROM OWID.PUBLIC.GDP_PER_CAPITA WHERE YEAR = 2020) SELECT le20.ENTITY, (le20.LIFE_EXPECTANCY - le90.LIFE_EXPECTANCY) AS life_expectancy_gain, g.GDP_PER_CAPITA FROM life_exp_2020 AS le20 JOIN life_exp_1990 AS le90 ON le20.ENTITY = le90.ENTITY JOIN gdp_2020 AS g ON le20.ENTITY = g.ENTITY ORDER BY life_expectancy_gain DESC LIMIT 5
results.truth_sql:
SELECT A.ENTITY, B.LIFE_EXPECTANCY - A.LIFE_EXPECTANCY, G.GDP_PER_CAPITA
FROM OWID.PUBLIC.LIFE_EXPECTANCY A JOIN OWID.PUBLIC.LIFE_EXPECTANCY B ON A.ENTITY = B.ENTITY
JOIN OWID.PUBLIC.GDP_PER_CAPITA G ON G.ENTITY = A.ENTITY AND G.YEAR = 2020
WHERE A.YEAR = 1990 AND B.YEAR = 2020 AND (A.CODE IS NOT NULL AND (LENGTH(A.CODE) = 3 OR A.CODE = 'OWID_KOS'))
ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5
assumptions: Used only country rows (ISO alpha-3 code or Kosovo) for the ranking
Calculated gain as the difference in life expectancy between the years 2020 and 1990
